headline: The canopy has men, and the claim lock can see live lanes now
lede: Contra's jungle drops a harness-man on every bough — perch, coil-glint, silent drop, land-and-fight. Behind the scenes the factory fixed the bug that kept re-kicking slots onto issues whose holder was demonstrably alive.

notes.text: CONTRA #3067: canopy frogmen live — perch above the trail, telegraph the coil with a glint, drop silently, stagger on the deck, then fight as the rifle runner. Every pass re-arms the boughs; 438/438 checks and the frog-blind/land-tax mutants die by name.

#3072: claim liveness no longer depends on magic words — any comment in a lane's own namespace refreshes the 90-min lock (except yielding/claim-dead/waiting-on-Jon), the warden refuses to reassign an issue whose holder session is provably alive, and FORGE.md prescribes the checkpoint shape. The #3053 fixture ships as a permanent gate.
Shelf honest-dry tonight: every flagship gap owned, no queue, no next. The new-title ask re-opens ~Nov 27 under Jon's answer cap.

look.text: Contra — read the glint above the trail; the drop is the whole attack
